   **Баги и стабильность.**
      18 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 8 июн. 2026 г. - 21 авг. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _C0NN0RAD0_, 21 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "I used to really love opal but the last few months it’s went really down hill and very buggy, I often find it not locking apps at the end of breaks, certain rules not staying paused or reset despite asking them to be reset or paused for xyz time, the app frequently freezing. I can no longer rely on it to reliably enforce screen time and habits."
            2. _f_hooper_, 16 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "So disappointed by the new update, used to use this app all the time and it was so helpful; now it's unusable and cash-grabby. Will be deleting and trying something else."
            3. _S.ley1'_, 4 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "The app glitches. Sometimes it blocks outside block moments and then doesn't unblock or the app completely malfunctions."
